turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Let me work through one example first.
Take the word "island". I listen to its first sound: "i". That is a vowel sound, so I choose an: They live on an island.
The rule: we use an before a vowel sound and a before any other sound.
Right: She drives a car. Wrong: She drives an car.

Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
